settings.title: ABOUT US
settings.subtitle: Elevating daily self-care into a transformative, clinical-luxury ritual designed to make you look and feel your absolute best.

settings.heading: Welcome to TENICIDE
settings.body_text: We created TENICIDE because we wanted to create the best health and beauty products in the world. We noticed a lack of premium, effective, and trustworthy essentials in the market, so we decided to create our own.
settings.pillar_1_desc: We are a team of health and beauty enthusiasts dedicated to redefining self-care. We believe that everyone deserves access to products that not only make them look good but also feel good from the inside out.
settings.pillar_2_desc: At TENICIDE, we curate and offer a premium range of health and beauty products. From skincare essentials to wellness solutions, every product is carefully selected, tested, and designed to deliver real results.
settings.pillar_3_desc: We believe that beauty and wellness shouldn't be a luxury, nor should it be a compromise. Our mission is to provide you with high-quality products that elevate your daily routine and boost your confidence, without any harmful shortcuts.
